name: Ombi
tagline: Friendly media request tool, automatically syncs with your media servers!
description: Ombi is a self-hosted web application that automatically gives your shared Plex or Emby users the ability to request content by themselves! Ombi can be linked to multiple TV Show and Movie DVR tools to create a seamless end-to-end experience for your users.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  ombi:
    environment:
      BASE_URL: /ombi
      PGID: "1000"
      PUID: "1000"
      TZ: Europe/London
    image: linuxserver/ombi:4.53.5
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 3579
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
    container_name: ombi
